summary: Clearwater Paper filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 disclosing entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with AgWest Farm Credit, PCA as administrative agent, comprising a $200 million borrowing-base revolver ($15 million drawn, $10 million letter-of-credit sublimit) and a fully drawn $275 million term loan. Proceeds redeemed all $275 million of the 2028 Notes, terminated the JPMorgan ABL facility, and paid fees. An accordion permits up to $100 million of additional revolver commitments after FY2027 financials. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage and covenant headroom.
